_comment: Hunt patterns shipped with SHELLHOUND. Read-only: this file lives in the
package, not in the workspace, so an upgrade brings new entries and the
analyst's own library is never touched. An entry can be switched off per
workspace; it cannot be edited, because editing it while it keeps its id
and its CVE would make the same identifier mean different things on two
WHAT A HIT PROVES: that a request was made. Nothing here says the request
succeeded, and nothing here is a finding on its own -- the status code
decides, and that is what the hunt reports back. A wave of 404s against
these paths is a scanner; one 200 is the sentence you write the report
THE SET IS DELIBERATELY SHORT. A pattern that ships is one every
installation runs, so a false positive here does not cost one analyst a
look -- it costs all of them a filled work list. Entries are added when
somebody has actually hunted with them, through the hunt pattern issue
form, not because a path appears on a scanner list.
ids are stable strings, never regenerated: the per-workspace off-switch
'*' is a wildcard. These are path matches, not regular expressions.

patterns.label: Joomla JCE image manager upload
patterns.about: The JCE editor's file manager has carried more than one upload flaw. Long-lived and still scanned. Verify the exact advisory against the JCE version in the CMS inventory before naming one in a report.
